blocks.text: No external test library is needed: every function written as `fn test_*():` is a unit test automatically. A test fails by `panic`king.

code: fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32:

blocks.text: You can also write a `test` block; its body is normal code and the test fails if a `require` is false. The block belongs to the function right above it and `main` does not call it.

code: fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32:
gg test src/ --json      # the same result as JSON

blocks.q: How does a `fn test_*()` function fail?
blocks.why: A `panic` counts as a failed test.
